sentence: The room's organizing can be restated in the model's terms through P01/P02/P03/P04/P05/P08/P10/P11/P12/P23, and none of the unused concepts shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts; the eight off-platform Discord pointers are covered by P23 and do not leave the restatement undecided.

The room's organizing restates in the model's terms — a member starts and calls for help (R01, P01, P15), the room fixes its design and placement pattern (P02, P04), builds (P03), keeps the mark against Void and moves twice (P05, K02, P10), talks borders and spares battlecats and Terraria (P08, P07, P16), and records the close (P11, P12) — and none of its unused concepts shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts, the Discord updates and moves being the model's own P23 and P10 with their decisions reported back in the thread.
